in_marathi.name: Vineetraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vineetraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vineetraj is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Vinyas' meaning victory and 'Raj' meaning ruler or king. It is a powerful name signifying victory, strength, and courage. It is believed to bring success and prosperity in all areas of life.
